messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] 03:42 UTC — Ingress throttling cascade detected in us-east1 impacting hosted inference. Elevated 5xx rates and increased latencies observed. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-21765 @channel

alex.nguyen: Investigating. Oncall SRE here. Seeing ingress proxies hitting request queue limit and backend backpressure. Triage running.

samir: I'm checking autoscaler logs and router errors. Early hypothesis: sudden client burst + KV cache eviction causing longer tail.

maria-l: Notifying CS/Support. Will draft external status note — need impact window and mitigation ETA.

devon: Affected customers: 6 enterprise tenants in us-east1 (IDs shared to Support). Raising priority for customers with SLA.

alex.nguyen: Mitigation plan: 1) Temporarily bump ingress rate limit for hosted tier in us-east1 2) Enable fallback routing to us-central cold capacity for low-priority traffic 3) Scale up proxy pools if needed. Executing step 1 now.

samir: Command run:
```
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap ingress-throttle --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_rps":"12000"}}'
```
Applied; replicas healthy. Monitoring.

ops-bot: Update 03:50 UTC — rate limit increase applied. 5xx rate down ~40% over 8 minutes. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ingress/alerts?from=now-30m

alex.nguyen: Enabled fallback routing for non-SLA routes. Using routing tag "fallback=us-central". Should divert ~30% of requests off us-east1.

samir: Autoscaler did a partial scale (3 -> 12 nodes) for proxy fleet. Observed CPU back to normal.

maria-l: External status posted (internal draft reviewed) — https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-21765/summary — message: "Some Hosted API customers experienced 5xx errors in us-east1; mitigation in progress; partial restore."

devon: Support note: advise customers to retry, mention fallback routing. For those with heavy errors we've opened tickets and escalated.

ops-bot: Update 04:08 UTC — latency and error budget trending towards normal. Continuing to monitor for 30m. Eng oncall recommends keeping increased throttle for 1 hour then step down.

paul: Root-cause checkpoint: initial trigger is a malformed heavy-burst from partner X hitting long-sequence endpoints which prevented efficient KV cache hits; working with partner to throttle.

alex.nguyen: Next steps: 1) finish blameless RCA kickoff 2) schedule postmortem + timeline 3) make temporary routing rule permanent until autoscaler fixes are validated.

samir: Added a short-lived circuit breaker to prevent single-customer flood from exhausting ingress: cfg id cb-2026-21765.

ops-bot: Final update 04:35 UTC — Partial restore; most routes normal. Incident status: mitigated. Postmortem link placeholder: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/INC-2026-21765 (will be populated). Closing channel for updates; reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:
